code: local out={} for _,fn in ipairs({'Pass12','Pass13','Pass14','Pass15','Pass16','Pass17','Pass18','Pass19','Islands','Landmarks','Planting'}) do local f=workspace.Plaza[fn] local cnt={} for _,c in f:GetChildren() do cnt[c.Name]=(cnt[c.Name] or 0)+1 end local s={} for k,v in cnt do table.insert(s,k..'x'..v) end table.insert(out,fn..': '..table.concat(s,' ')) end return table.concat(out,'\n')
